verdict.rationale: Vercel documents emitting custom application metrics from Vercel Functions and analyzing them in its Observability product, alongside built-in traffic, function-performance and error monitoring. That is a thin, Vercel-scoped slice of the story: no evidence shows user-built custom dashboards or ingesting metrics from arbitrary external services. Missing for 10: documented custom dashboard builder, combining metrics from external/any services, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service

citations.quote: Learn how to emit application-specific metrics from Vercel Functions and analyze them in Observability.
